ski: Snow reaches the Washington Cascades Friday, then Saturday dries out before more snow Sunday. Most snow: West Slopes North, 6-10 in of heavy snow, NWAC has no rating posted.
hike: Dry today across the mountains, with snow in the Washington Cascades and Olympics Friday. Driest Friday is at Wenatchee Foothills, with 0.01 in of water, clear in one model and under cloud in the other, NWAC has no rating posted. Gusts reach 35 mph at Hood Canal North on Friday.
